quotes.quote: We call that person who has lost his father, an orphan; and a widower that man who has lost his wife. But that man who has known the immense unhappiness of losing a friend, by what name do we call him? Here every language is silent and holds its peace in impotence.
quotes.author: Joseph Roux

quotes.quote: In his face there came to be a brooding peace that is seen most often in the faces of the very sorrowful or the very wise. But still he wandered through the streets of the town, always silent and alone.
quotes.author: Carson McCullers,  The Heart is a Lonely Hunter

quotes.quote: The more humble and obedient to God a man is, the more wise and at peace he will be in all that he does.
quotes.author: Thomas Ã  Kempis,  The Inner Life

quotes.quote: Sweet are the thoughts that savour of content, The quiet mind is richer than a crown...
quotes.author: Robert Greene

quotes.quote: I could be in the middle of a spiritual hurricane, my soul torn and tormented, but when I see you smile it's blue skies for miles. You give me a tsunami of emotions, and my heart is trying to find peace through crashing waves, but they always end up in a cyclone that never dies.-Jarod Kintz and Karen Quan
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  liQUID PROse QUOtes

quotes.quote: Accomplishments don't erase shame, hatred, cruelty, silence, ignorance, discrimination, low self-esteem or immorality. It covers it up, with a creative version of pride and ego. Only restitution, forgiving yourself and others, compassion, repentance and living with dignity will ever erase the past.
quotes.author: Shannon L. Alder

quotes.quote: In the midst of happiness or despairin sorrow or in joyin pleasure or in pain:Do what is right and you will be at peace.
quotes.author: Jess Rothenberg,  The Catastrophic History of You and Me

quotes.quote: Watch any plant or animal and let it teach you acceptance of what is, surrender to the Now.Let it teach you Being.Let it teach you integrity -- which means to be one, to be yourself, to be real.Let it teach you how to live and how to die, and how not to make living and dying into a problem.
quotes.author: Eckhart Tolle,  The Power of Now: A Guide to Spiritual Enlightenment

quotes.quote: Peace is not the absence of conflict but the presence of creative alternatives for responding to conflict -- alternatives to passive or aggressive responses, alternatives to violence.
quotes.author: Dorothy Thompson

quotes.quote: I find peace when I'm confused, I find hope when I'm let down, not in me but in you.
quotes.author: Switchfoot

quotes.quote: Peace is not a result inside us from everything around us. Peace is not submissive nor passive. On the contrary, peace is an overwhelming force which comes from within us, disrespectful of everything around us, a firm coalition of spirit and soul standing against all the unrest that abounds.
quotes.author: C. JoyBell C.

quotes.quote: Ours is a world of nuclear giants and ethical infants. We know more about war than we know about peace, more about killing than we know about living. We have grasped the mystery of the atom and rejected the Sermon on the Mount.
quotes.author: Omar Nelson Bradley

quotes.quote: You talk when you cease to be at peace with your thoughts;And when you can no longer dwell in the solitude of your heart you live in your lips, and sound is a diversion and a pastime.And in much of your talking, thinking is half murdered.
quotes.author: Kahlil Gibran,  The Prophet

quotes.quote: Make peace with silence, and remind yourself that it is in this space that you'll come to remember your spirit. When you're able to transcend an aversion to silence, you'll also transcend many other miseries. And it is in this silence that the remembrance of God will be activated.
quotes.author: Wayne W. Dyer

quotes.quote: They'll say you are bador perhaps you are mador at least you should stay undercover.Your mind must be bareif you would dareto think you can love more than one lover.
quotes.author: David Rovics

quotes.quote: I have a self-made quote: Celebrate diversity, practice acceptance and may we all choose peaceful options to conflict.
quotes.author: Donzella Michele Malone

quotes.quote: Love is our most unifying and empowering common spiritual denominator. The more we ignore its potential to bring greater balance and deeper meaning to human existence, the more likely we are to continue to define history as one long inglorious record of man's inhumanity to man.
quotes.author: Aberjhani,  Journey through the Power of the Rainbow: Quotations from a Life Made Out of Poetry

quotes.quote: Remember your humanity, and forget the rest.
quotes.author: Bertrand Russell

quotes.quote: Kindness has no religion. Religions are like narrow tracks but kindness is like an open sky.
quotes.author: Amit Ray,  Nonviolence: The Transforming Power

quotes.quote: Don't live by my words, don't die by them, chew them slowly digest them, and smile if they give nourishment to your soul.
quotes.author: Stanley Victor Paskavich

quotes.quote: How aware are we of our own inner life, our spirituality-something so intangible yet so priceless? How much effort do we make to perceive that which is not obvious, which can neither be seen nor heard? I believe the exploration and enrichment of the human spirit is what determines our very humanity. Such enrichment provides an inner compass that can lead civilizations to greatness.
quotes.author: Daisaku Ikeda

quotes.quote: Your words will either give you joy or give you sorrow, but if they were spoken without regret, they give you peace.
quotes.author: Shannon L. Alder

quotes.quote: I shall have peace, as leafy trees are peaceful When rain bends down the bough; And I shall be more silent and cold-hearted Than you are now.
quotes.author: Sara Teasdale,  Rivers to the Sea

quotes.quote: The path of peace is not a passive journey. It takes incredible strength not to open a can of 'whoop-ass', justifiably, when ones button is pushed.
quotes.author: T.F. Hodge,  From Within I Rise: Spiritual Triumph Over Death and Conscious Encounters with "The Divine Presence"

quotes.quote: It's much easier on the emotions when one sees life as an experiment rather than a struggle for popularity.
quotes.author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

quotes.quote: Be patient. Your skin took a while to deteriorate. Give it some time to reflect a calmer inner state. As one of my friends states on his Facebook profile: "The true Losers in Life, are not those who Try and Fail, but those who Fail to Try.
quotes.author: Jess C. Scott,  Clear: A Guide to Treating Acne Naturally

quotes.quote: No one is to blame because there is no one other than you. Nothing is to disrespect because there is nothing other than you.
quotes.author: Amit Ray

quotes.quote: Solitude is the house of peace.
quotes.author: T.F. Hodge,  From Within I Rise: Spiritual Triumph Over Death and Conscious Encounters with "The Divine Presence"

quotes.quote: Having beef with someone is unnecessary and avoidable. Whatever the issue, if not positive, it is an opportunity to cut the excess fat from an unhealthy dietary network. Simply excuse yourself from the table of negativity and lean forward in peace.
quotes.author: T.F. Hodge,  From Within I Rise: Spiritual Triumph Over Death and Conscious Encounters with "The Divine Presence"

quotes.quote: Stand up for what is right even if you stand alone.
quotes.author: Suzy Kassem

quotes.quote: God favors men and women who delight in being made worthy of happiness before the happiness itself.
quotes.author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

quotes.quote: What drains your spirit drains your body. What fuels your spirit fuels your body.
quotes.author: Caroline Myss,  Anatomy of the Spirit

quotes.quote: God wanted to make heaven and the earth is that heaven. Nowhere in the universe there is so much love, life, beauty and peace. Enjoy your stay with the fellow beings.
quotes.author: Amit Ray,  Nonviolence: The Transforming Power

quotes.quote: There is never a moment when God is not in control. Relax! He's got you covered.
quotes.author: Mandy Hale,  The Single Woman: Life, Love, and a Dash of Sass

quotes.quote: What you are, and who you are should provide greater clarity about where you have been and where you are headed. Although one distinguishes spiritual from physical nature, the ultimate unification of the two is the consequence of the struggle for internal, external and eternal - peace.
quotes.author: T.F. Hodge,  From Within I Rise: Spiritual Triumph Over Death and Conscious Encounters with "The Divine Presence"

quotes.quote: Ø¥Ù† Ø¹Ø¨Ø§Ø¯Ø© Ø§Ù„Ø¥Ù„Ù‡ Ø§Ù„ÙˆØ§Ø­Ø¯ ÙˆØ­Ø¯Ù‡Ø§ Ø³ØªÙ‚Ø±Ø¨ Ø§Ù„Ø§Ù†Ø³Ø§Ù† Ù…Ù† Ø§Ù„Ø³Ù„Ø§Ù… Ø§Ù„Ø°ÙŠ ÙŠØªÙƒÙ„Ù… Ø¹Ù„ÙŠÙ‡ Ø§Ù„Ø¬Ù…ÙŠØ¹ ÙˆÙ„Ø§ÙŠÙØ¹Ù„ Ø£Ø­Ø¯ Ø´ÙŠØ¦Ø§Ù‹ Ù„ØªØ­Ù‚ÙŠÙ‚Ù‡.
quotes.author: Malcolm X

quotes.quote: When you know the knower within, you don't need to know further. When you know the meditator within, you don't need to meditate further. When you truly know the worshiper in you, you are to be worshiped.
quotes.author: Amit Ray,  Nonviolence: The Transforming Power

quotes.quote: Souls reconstructed with faith transform agony into peace.
quotes.author: Aberjhani,  The River of Winged Dreams

quotes.quote: A life of happiness, peace, and love is all within our grasp.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: If you are driven by fear, anger or pride nature will force you to compete. If you are guided by courage, awareness, tranquility and peace nature will serve you.
quotes.author: Amit Ray,  Nonviolence: The Transforming Power

quotes.quote: Peace has to be created, in order to be maintained. It is the product of Faith, Strength, Energy, Will, Sympathy, Justice, Imagination, and the triumph of principle. It will never be achieved by passivity and quietism.
quotes.author: Dorothy Thompson

quotes.quote: In great contests each party claims to act in accordance with the will of God. Both may be, and one must be wrong. God cannot be for, and against the same thing at the same time.
quotes.author: Abraham Lincoln

quotes.quote: In joined hands there is still some token of hope, in the clinched fist none.
quotes.author: Victor Hugo,  The Toilers of the Sea

quotes.quote: One who will not accept solitude, stillness and quiet recurring moments...is caught up in the wilderness of addictions; far removed from an original state of being and awareness. This is 'dis-ease.
quotes.author: T.F. Hodge,  From Within I Rise: Spiritual Triumph Over Death and Conscious Encounters with "The Divine Presence"

quotes.quote: As we leave the Moon at Taurus-Littrow, we leave as we came, and God willing, as we shall return, with peace and hope for all mankind.
quotes.author: Eugene Cernan

quotes.quote: People will always notice something about you. It might be the way you walk or the way you talk, or just simply your personality. Live each day in the way you want to be remembered. Live in such a way that people will be inspired by those unique qualities that you have and strive to live better lives for themselves.
quotes.author: Amaka Imani Nkosazana

quotes.quote: A religion that takes no account of practical affairs and does not help to solve them is no religion.
quotes.author: Mahatma Gandhi

quotes.quote: Easily mistaken, it is not about a love for adversity, it is about knowing a strength and a faith so great that adversity, in all its adverse manifestations, hardly even exists.
quotes.author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

quotes.quote: She wished she could visit Mariam's grave, to sit with her awhile, leave a flower or two. But she sees now that it doesn't matter. Mariam is never very far.... Mariam is in her own heart, where she shines with the bursting radiance of a thousand suns.
quotes.author: Khaled Hosseini,  A Thousand Splendid Suns

quotes.quote: When love and hate are both absent, everything becomes clear and undisguised. Make the slightest distinction, however, and heaven and earth are set infinitely apart. If you wish to see the truth, then hold no opinions for or against anything. To set up what you like against what you dislike is the disease of the mind.
quotes.author: Hsin Hsin Ming

quotes.quote: Peace is what enables development and is critical in providing opportunities to young people. Efforts to preserve peace are absolutely vital in bringing prosperity and hope for the future.
quotes.author: Kim Yuna

quotes.quote: The topic of compassion is not at all religious business; it is important to know it is human business, it is a question of human survival.
quotes.author: Dalai Lama XIV

quotes.quote: Just above our terror, the stars painted this storyin perfect silver calligraphy. And our souls, too oftenabused by ignorance, covered our eyes with mercy.
quotes.author: Aberjhani,  I Made My Boy Out of Poetry

quotes.quote: To die,so young to die.No, no, not I,I love the warm sunny skies,light, song, shining eyes,I want no war, no battle cry,No, no, not I.
quotes.author: Hannah Senesh

quotes.quote: Believe what you believe and it will be, believe what others believe and they will consume you!
quotes.author: Stanley Victor Paskavich

quotes.quote: Those who live as though God sets the rules are not going by their own rules. That is the self-sacrifice, or selflessness, that peace more often than not requires. Those who insist on going by their own rules cannot make that sacrifice. They are the steady adherents of (global) conflict because they are forever fighting both themselves and others to do whatever they think that they want to do.
quotes.author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

quotes.quote: If you are a Buddhist, inspire yourself by thinking of the bodhisattva. If you are a Christian, think of the Christ, who came not to be served by others but to serve them in joy, in peace, and in generosity. For these things, these are not mere words, but acts, which go all the way, right up to their last breath. Even their death is a gift, and resurrection is born from this kind of death. (157)
quotes.author: Jean-Yves Leloup,  Compassion and Meditation: The Spiritual Dynamic between Buddhism and Christianity

quotes.quote: To look upon its grass grown yard, where the sunbeams seem to sleep so quietly, one would think that there at least the dead might rest in peace.
quotes.author: Washington Irving,  The Legend of Sleepy Hollow

quotes.quote: Happiness is a choice. Peace is a state of mind. Both are free!
quotes.author: Amy Leigh Mercree

quotes.quote: A brick could be used to perpetually feed the hungry, stop all wars, educate the masses, and ensure everlasting peace for all populations throughout time. Wait, I'm sorry, that's not right. I was confusing a brick with a blanket. It's a blanket that could be used for all those things.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  A brick and a blanket walk into a bar

quotes.quote: I only seem negative to the fortunate. That's because I show the less fortunate that they aren't less fortunate after all.
quotes.author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

quotes.quote: I am thankful when I am hungry because then I know that when I eat, the food will taste better. Life has taught me that my true contentment rests in hope, and the pleasure itself is secondary. It is self-awareness, not happiness, that maintains peace.
quotes.author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

quotes.quote: I've come to the point where I never feel the need to stop and evaluate whether or not I am happy. I'm just 'being', and without question, by default, it works.
quotes.author: Criss Jami,  Diotima, Battery, Electric Personality

quotes.quote: Culture is an elevated expression of the inner voice which the different peoples of the Earth have heard in the depths of their being, a voice which conveys the vibrant compassion and wisdom of the cosmic life. For different cultures to engage in interaction is to catalyze each other's souls and foster mutual understanding.
quotes.author: Daisaku Ikeda

quotes.quote: This world's anguish is no different from the love we insist on holding back.
quotes.author: Aberjhani,  Elemental: The Power of Illuminated Love

quotes.quote: Sex could be a blissful communion,. But it could also be a weapon, and its absence, sometimes, was required for the establishment of peace.
quotes.author: Ann Brashares,  Girls In Pants: The Third Summer of the Sisterhood

quotes.quote: With a philosophy education, one can infuriate his peers, intimidate his date, think of obscure, unreliable ways to make money, and never regret a thing.
quotes.author: Criss Jami,  Diotima, Battery, Electric Personality

quotes.quote: It brings hope and peace of mind knowing that God gave His only begotten Son for us. I'm able to look back and know that on this day Jesus was born and gave us the opportunity to have eternal life.
quotes.author: Adrian Peterson

quotes.quote: I enjoy melancholic music and art. They take me to places I don't normally get to go.
quotes.author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

quotes.quote: The greenest of pastures are right here on earth.
quotes.author: Jennifer Donnelly,  Revolution

quotes.quote: Peace is not so much a political mandate as it is a shared state of consciousness that remains elevated and intact only to the degree that those who value it volunteer their existence as living examples of the same... Peace ends with the unraveling of individual hope and the emergence of the will to worship violence as a healer of private and social dis-ease.
quotes.author: Aberjhani,  The American Poet Who Went Home Again

quotes.quote: Are you desperate or determined? With desperation comes frustration. With determination comes purpose, achievement, and peace....
quotes.author: James A. Murphy,  The Waves of Life Quotes and Daily Meditations

quotes.quote: Separate yourself from those who hinder your vision. Make a choice to walk away from the trap set to ensnare you. Realize when someone is pulling you backwards every time you take a step forward. Separate from them and the result of your action will be a life of success.
quotes.author: Amaka Imani Nkosazana

quotes.quote: Women particularly should concern themselves with peace because men by nature are more foolhardy and headstrong, and their overwhelming desire to avenge themselves prevents them from foreseeing the resulting dangers and terrors of war. But woman by nature is more gentle and circumspect. Therefore, if she has sufficient will and wisdom she can provide the best possible means to pacify man.
quotes.author: Christine de Pizan,  The Treasure of the City of Ladies

quotes.quote: To those peoples in the huts and villages of half the globe struggling to break the bonds of mass misery, we pledge our best efforts to help them help themselves, for whatever period is required - not because the Communists may be doing it, not because we seek their votes, but because it is right. If a free society cannot help the many who are poor, it cannot save the few who are rich.
quotes.author: John F. Kennedy

quotes.quote: There lies before us, if we choose, continual progress in happiness, knowledge and wisdom. Shall we instead choose death, because we cannot forget our quarrels? I appeal as a human being to human beings; remember your humanity, and forget the rest.
quotes.author: Bertrand Russell

quotes.quote: Speak up, stand up, and keep correcting the false perceptions. Stay true to your heart's views and keep chanting for peace and justice.
quotes.author: Suzy Kassem,  Rise Up and Salute the Sun: The Writings of Suzy Kassem

quotes.quote: Imagination doesn't always make you long for what you cannot have, but rather thrive in what you do not have.
quotes.author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

quotes.quote: Peaceful disputes are maintained when men sincerely believe that they are morally, logically correct about the issues at hand. It is when neither side is really certain that wars are instigated.
quotes.author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

quotes.quote: To become a true global citizen, one must abandon all notions of 'otherness' and instead embrace 'togetherness'.
quotes.author: Suzy Kassem,  Rise Up and Salute the Sun: The Writings of Suzy Kassem

quotes.quote: The study of the art of motorcycle maintenance is really a miniature study of the art of rationality itself. Working on a motorcycle, working well, caring, is to become part of a process, to achieve an inner peace of mind. The motorcycle is primarily a mental phenomenon.
quotes.author: Robert M. Pirsig

quotes.quote: Be thankful for a breath of fresh air to be alive and well. Allow love and happiness to penetrate throughout your mind and soul. Take time to relax and live in the moment, the now, the present. Enjoy today.
quotes.author: Amaka Imani Nkosazana

quotes.quote: Truth is not for sale. The man who sells truths that could help and guide humanity will never have peace of mind. Share truths freely, and you will always be revealed more.
quotes.author: Suzy Kassem,  Rise Up and Salute the Sun: The Writings of Suzy Kassem

quotes.quote: The positive vibrations of unregulated joy, peace, happiness and tranquility is freedom.
quotes.author: T.F. Hodge,  From Within I Rise: Spiritual Triumph Over Death and Conscious Encounters with "The Divine Presence"

quotes.quote: Some people have just rented your body to live in it for sometime and depart. Others consider you as a permanent residence to dwell in forever. Which ever, you must remember to accommodate all those who want to be accommodated. Be each other's keeper
quotes.author: Israelmore Ayivor

quotes.quote: A man of God would never burn or harm a temple of any kind - regardless of religion. A true man of God would see every temple or divine mansion built to glorify the Creator - as an extension of the temple closest to his home, regardless of its shape, size, or color. A man who truly recognizes and knows God can see God in all things.
quotes.author: Suzy Kassem,  Rise Up and Salute the Sun: The Writings of Suzy Kassem

quotes.quote: You never know who you're inspiring or uninspiring. People notice more than you think.
quotes.author: Amaka Imani Nkosazana

quotes.quote: To sense the peace of extinguished passionHappiness in not knowing the ultimate knowledge
quotes.author: Dejan Stojanovic,  The Sign and Its Children

quotes.quote: Accept the universeAs the gods gave it to you.If the gods wanted to give you something elseThey'd have done it.If there are other matters and other worldsThere are.
quotes.author: Alberto Caeiro,  The Collected Poems of Alberto Caeiro

quotes.quote: The ultimate source of comfort and peace is within ourselves.
quotes.author: Dalai Lama XIV

quotes.quote: A leader should always be open to criticism, not silencing dissent. Any leader who does not tolerate criticism from the public is afraid of their dirty hands to be revealed under heavy light. And such a leader is dangerous, because they only feel secure in the darkness. Only a leader who is free from corruption welcomes scrutiny; for scrutiny allows a good leader to be an even greater leader.
quotes.author: Suzy Kassem,  Rise Up and Salute the Sun: The Writings of Suzy Kassem

quotes.quote: The Grateful Dead, they're my best friends. Their message of hope, peace, love, teamwork, creativity, imagination, celebration, the dance, the vision, the purpose, the passion all of the things I believe in makes me the luckiest Deadhead in the world.
quotes.author: Bill Walton

quotes.quote: Kuikaribisha amani ya Mungu katika maisha yangu kumenisaidia. Naishi mbinguni duniani.
quotes.author: Enock Maregesi

quotes.quote: How many fears came between us?Earthquakes, diseases, wars where hellrained smoldering pus from skies made of winged death.Horror tore this world asunder.While inside the bleeding smokeand beyond the shredded weeping fleshwe memorized tales of infinite good.--from The History Lesson
quotes.author: Aberjhani,  Elemental: The Power of Illuminated Love

quotes.quote: With no positivity, there is no hope; with no negativity, there is no improvement.
quotes.author: Criss Jami,  Healology

quotes.quote: There is nothing more powerful than truth. It is undeniable and should always be appreciated. The truth gives you unlimited freedom to be who you are and express how you feel. The truth offers you peace of mind which is something we all love.
quotes.author: Amaka Imani Nkosazana

quotes.quote: Women united can create movements. We can empower entire generations. We can build peace one action at a time. Together we rise. The time is now.
quotes.author: Amy Leigh Mercree

quotes.quote: Being a senior doesn't automatically make one wise but the wise & foolish alike have things to teach us.
quotes.author: Allan Lokos,  Pocket Peace: Effective Practices for Enlightened Living

quotes.quote: We train the mind so that we can enjoy greater peace, happiness, wisdom & equanimity.
quotes.author: Allan Lokos,  Pocket Peace: Effective Practices for Enlightened Living

quotes.quote: A crude age. Peace is stabilized with cannon and bombers, humanity with concentration camps and pogroms. We're living in a time when all standards are turned upside-down, Kern. Today the aggressor is the shepherd of peace, and the beaten and hunted are the troublemakers of the world. What's more, there are whole races who believe it!
quotes.author: Erich Maria Remarque,  Flotsam: A Novel of World War II

quotes.quote: The line between him and the enemy had simultaneously blurred and solidified. Somehow, while perhaps it shouldn't have, this thought provided a strange sense of peace.
quotes.author: Kristina McMorris,  Bridge of Scarlet Leaves

quotes.quote: No matter how hard it is, or how hard it gets, don't ever, ever, ever lose hope!
quotes.author: Jim Yackel,  The Wayfarers | Walking Dreams

quotes.quote: The darker side of the City tried to emphasize the selfish parts of me by encouraging my sense of entitlement and my desire for personal space. But God seemed to whisper that the alternative existed: to let Him grow humility and concern for others in a way I had never experienced, to live out His peace amid whirling chaos. (p.67)
quotes.author: Tara Leigh Cobble,  Crowded Skies: Letters To Manhattan

quotes.quote: We can remove the veil that shrouds our understanding and made us forget who we truly are. When we understand the core self and live from the core self, the myth of separation, concepts of separation, color, religion, class, intelligence...all these fade away. We are not our color. We are not our religion. We are not our sexual preference. We are human beings. We are spiritual beings.
quotes.author: Cassandra Blizzard,  A World Without Color

quotes.quote: I am thankful to all the souls, I meet in the journey of life.
quotes.author: Lailah Gifty Akita,  Think Great: Be Great!

quotes.quote: Love and honor the world around you, and you experience life in its fullest. There is no 'Other.' There is simply us. The all of us, the whole of us. The mankind of us. Anything else is a lie.
quotes.author: Cassandra Blizzard

quotes.quote: One day, your light will silence the darkness, and you will be surrounded by the beauty within.
quotes.author: A.D. Posey

quotes.quote: Transform into your dream.
quotes.author: A.D. Posey

quotes.quote: Going to war to establish peace will not bring peace. It will just kill you.
quotes.author: Debasish Mridha

quotes.quote: I choose to live in peace today. I choose to get lost in my inner beauty today.
quotes.author: Debasish Mridha

quotes.quote: When you love yourself, then you are at peace. Wants or needs cannot destroy it
quotes.author: Debasish Mridha

quotes.quote: My mind is an instrument of peaceI am the peaceMy heart sing the song of peaceMy mind dances with peaceI laugh with peaceMy soul is longing for peaceMy spirit is the source of peace.
quotes.author: Debasish Mridha

quotes.quote: Our daily gratitude shapes our everyday attitude.
quotes.author: H.L. Balcomb

quotes.quote: Beauty is a heart with wings.
quotes.author: A.D. Posey

quotes.quote: Believe in people, they fly for a day. Teach them to believe in themselves, they soar for a lifetime.
quotes.author: A.D. Posey

quotes.quote: Happiness is individualized. Don't box it in. Let it fly.
quotes.author: A.D. Posey

quotes.quote: Be one with yourself and revel in eternal bliss.
quotes.author: A.D. Posey

quotes.quote: A loving heart, determination, faith, courage, trust, belief, truth, and a solid soul create the wings with which we fly.
quotes.author: A.D. Posey

quotes.quote: Drizzle happiness wherever you go.
quotes.author: A.D. Posey

quotes.quote: Believe so brightly that everyone sees the beauty in believing.
quotes.author: A.D. Posey

quotes.quote: Life is magic.
quotes.author: A.D. Posey

quotes.quote: Every day is not a day to master but an adventure to experience.
quotes.author: A.D. Posey

quotes.quote: Kind words change the world.
quotes.author: A.D. Posey

quotes.quote: Film gives us a second chance at a first impression.
quotes.author: A.D. Posey

quotes.quote: Be still in peace and reach your highest peak.
quotes.author: A.D. Posey

quotes.quote: The best writing speaks when the heart whispers.
quotes.author: A.D. Posey

quotes.quote: Her words are her wings. She's flying.
quotes.author: A.D. Posey

quotes.quote: When is now.
quotes.author: A.D. Posey

quotes.quote: Whatever you do, let it be lovely.
quotes.author: A.D. Posey

quotes.quote: Love is alive when there's music in your heart.
quotes.author: A.D. Posey

quotes.quote: Love is enough.
quotes.author: A.D. Posey

quotes.quote: Like a flower, feel yourself rise above and begin to open.
quotes.author: A.D. Posey

quotes.quote: Greatness is achieved through kindness, compassion, and love.
quotes.author: A.D. Posey

quotes.quote: Every day, live in a way that honors who you are.
quotes.author: A.D. Posey

quotes.quote: Think about peace, dream about peace, and take action to make the world peaceful.
quotes.author: Debasish Mridha

quotes.quote: We will not be able to find peace if our minds are burning with the fires of resentment. Let us forgive and forget to create peace.
quotes.author: Debasish Mridha

quotes.quote: Peace is always pleasant, always kind.

quotes.quote: Peace is not only the goal, it is the game itself.

quotes.quote: Create the kind of peace in your mind that you want to see in the world.

quotes.quote: Believe God for something today. Prayer is the key to connecting with God and allowing Him to speak to your spirit. Open your heart and free your mind.
quotes.author: Amaka Imani Nkosazana,  Heart Crush

quotes.quote: A person with too many secrets has no happiness but burden. He/She cant find joy or peace, but those secrets enslave him or her. It doesn't matter how many secrets you keep but at the end truth always comes out. Why then burden yourself with secrets.

quotes.quote: Find calmness in storms. Find beauty in ugliness. Find peace in the midst of war. Now expand it. Only people with a higher consciousness can do this. It will make the world a better place for mankind.

quotes.quote: Pure Soul and circumstances; there are only these two; but the disturbance of egoism does not allow it to be at peace.

quotes.quote: Love is written by the soul.
